scripts.code:
--[[
================================================================================
  ADMINJOY v3  |  GUI EDITION  |  LAG-FREE REBUILD
================================================================================
  NO external loadstrings (KohlsNoob / SkidNation X both REMOVED — they were
  the lag source). Pure AdminJoy, lightweight, no namecall hooks.
  TextBox focus auto-released so you can ALWAYS move (WASD never gets stolen).

  OPEN UI:  click the ⚡ button (left side)  or  press RIGHT-CTRL
  TARGET:   set at top (me/all/others/random/name)  —  VALUE box for numbers
  TABS:     Visuals / OP / Player / Server / Fun / Settings
================================================================================
]]

local PREFIX       = "!"
local KOHLS_PREFIX = ";"
local ACCENT       = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 180)
local ACCENT2      = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
local BG_DARK      = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 22)
local BG_MID       = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 36)
local SHOWOFF      = true
local ANTI_KICK    = true

local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService        = game:GetService("GuiService")
local TeleportService   = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TextChatService   = pcall(function() return game:GetService("TextChatService") end) and game:GetService("TextChatService") or nil
local LocalPlayer       = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui         = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Safe focus release (UserInputService has NO ReleaseFocus method; calling it
-- spammed red errors every click/Enter. GuiService.SelectedObject = nil is
-- the supported path, fully pcall-guarded).
local function releaseFocus()
    pcall(function() GuiService.SelectedObject = nil end)
    local sel = GuiService.SelectedObject
    if sel then pcall(function() sel:ReleaseFocus(false) end) end
end

--===========================================================================--
--  CHAT / REMOTE (lightweight — no hooks)
--===========================================================================--
--===========================================================================--
--  MULTI-CHANNEL COMMAND ENGINE  (works even when muted)
--  Priority: dedicated admin RemoteEvent/Function > chat remotes >
--  TextChatService. A muted player's chat is rejected server-side; admin
--  remotes bypass chat moderation entirely, so commands still fire.
--===========================================================================--
local CHAT_REMOTES  = {}
local ADMIN_REMOTES = {}
local ADMIN_FUNCS   = {}
local legacySay     = nil  -- DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest (this game's real command pipe)

local ADMIN_KEYS = {"admin","command","kohl","cmd","handler","executor","announcer","permission","staff","net","modsys"}

local function discoverRemotes()
    table.clear(CHAT_REMOTES); table.clear(ADMIN_REMOTES); table.clear(ADMIN_FUNCS)
    legacySay = nil
    local okE, ev = pcall(function() return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") end)
    if okE and ev then legacySay = ev:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") end
    local containers = {ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, Workspace}
    if LocalPlayer then
        table.insert(containers, LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts)
        table.insert(containers, LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
    end
    for _, cont in ipairs(containers) do
        local ok, desc = pcall(function() return cont:GetDescendants() end)
        if ok and desc then
            for _, obj in ipairs(desc) do
                local n  = obj.Name:lower()
                local isR = obj:IsA("RemoteEvent")
                local isF = obj:IsA("RemoteFunction")
                if (isR or isF) and obj ~= legacySay then
                    if n:match("message") or n:match("chat") or n:match("say") then
                        if isR then table.insert(CHAT_REMOTES, obj) end
                    end
                    local hit = false
                    for _, k in ipairs(ADMIN_KEYS) do
                        if n:find(k, 1, true) then hit = true; break end
                    end
                    if hit then
                        if isR then table.insert(ADMIN_REMOTES, obj)
                        elseif isF then table.insert(ADMIN_FUNCS, obj) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
discoverRemotes()
-- late remotes / chat system appear after load; keep rescanning quietly
task.spawn(function()
    local ev = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents", 12)
    if ev then legacySay = ev:WaitForChild("SayMessageRequest", 6) end
    for _ = 1, 25 do task.wait(3); discoverRemotes() end
end)

-- Legacy chat command pipe. Channel "System" = admin commands (bypasses the
-- chat flood/moderation gate, exactly how Kohl's Noob drives this game);
-- channel "All" = visible public message everyone can read.
local function fireLegacy(message, channel)
    if not legacySay then return false end
    local ok = pcall(function() legacySay:FireServer(message, channel) end)
    return ok
end

local function fireAdminRemotes(full, plain)
    for idx, r in ipairs(ADMIN_REMOTES) do
        pcall(function()
            if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                r:FireServer(full)
                if idx == 1 then r:FireServer(plain); r:FireServer(LocalPlayer, full) end
            end
        end)
    end
    for _, r in ipairs(ADMIN_FUNCS) do
        pcall(function() r:InvokeServer(full) end)
    end
end

local function sendTextChat(message)
    if not TextChatService then return end
    pcall(function()
        local root = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
        if root then
            for _, ch in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("TextChannel") then pcall(function() ch:SendAsync(message) end) end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Public visible message (showoff banners / announces / hints).
local function say(message)
    fireLegacy(message, "All")
    for _, r in ipairs(CHAT_REMOTES) do pcall(function() r:FireServer(message, "All") end) end
    sendTextChat(message)
end

-- Admin command sender. Tries every spelling the Kohl's parser accepts:
-- ";cmd" (semicolon), ":cmd" (colon), bare "cmd". System channel first.
local function kohl(cmd)
    local semi  = KOHLS_PREFIX .. cmd
    local colon = ":" .. cmd
    fireAdminRemotes(semi, cmd)
    fireLegacy(semi,  "System")
    fireLegacy(colon, "System")
    fireLegacy(cmd,   "System")
    sendTextChat(semi)
end

local function kohlMulti(cmds, d)
    d = d or 0.06
    task.spawn(function()
        for _, c in ipairs(cmds) do kohl(c); task.wait(d) end
    end)
end

local function remoteStatus()
    local legacy = legacySay and "yes" or "no"
    local tch = "none"
    if TextChatService then
        local root = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
        if root then tch = tostring(#root:GetChildren()) end
    end
    return ("legacy=%s textch=%s admin=%d func=%d chat=%d"):format(legacy, tch, #ADMIN_REMOTES, #ADMIN_FUNCS, #CHAT_REMOTES)
end

local function flashAnnounce(text)
    if not SHOWOFF then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        say(";announce [AdminJoy v3] " .. text)
        task.wait(0.15)
        say(";hint >> " .. text)
    end)
end

--===========================================================================--
--  TARGET RESOLVER
--===========================================================================--
local function resolveTarget(arg)
    if not arg or arg == "" then return {LocalPlayer} end
    arg = arg:lower(); local r = {}
    if arg == "me" then table.insert(r, LocalPlayer)
    elseif arg == "all" then r = Players:GetPlayers()
    elseif arg == "others" then for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(r, p) end end
    elseif arg == "random" then local l = Players:GetPlayers(); if #l > 0 then table.insert(r, l[math.random(1, #l)]) end
    else for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower():find(arg, 1, true) or (p.DisplayName and p.DisplayName:lower():find(arg, 1, true)) then table.insert(r, p) end
    end end
    if #r == 0 then table.insert(r, LocalPlayer) end
    return r
end
local function names(plrs) local t={}; for _,p in ipairs(plrs) do table.insert(t,p.Name) end; return table.concat(t,",") end

--===========================================================================--
--  GUI  (lightweight — no constant loops)
--===========================================================================--
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AdminJoyV3"; ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling; ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

Toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 34); Toast.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0, -50)
Toast.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK; Toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15; Toast.Visible = false
Instance.new("UICorner", Toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local tStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); tStroke.Color = ACCENT; tStroke.Thickness = 1.5; tStroke.Transparency = 0.3; tStroke.Parent = Toast
local ToastLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
ToastLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,1,0); ToastLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,0)
ToastLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ToastLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; ToastLabel.TextSize = 13
ToastLabel.TextColor3 = ACCENT; ToastLabel.Parent = Toast
Toast.Parent = ScreenGui

local toastBusy = false
local function notify(msg, color)
    ToastLabel.Text = msg; ToastLabel.TextColor3 = color or ACCENT; tStroke.Color = color or ACCENT
    Toast.Visible = true
    if toastBusy then return end
    toastBusy = true
    TweenService:Create(Toast, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-190,0,14)}):Play()
    task.wait(3); TweenService:Create(Toast, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-190,0,-50)}):Play()
    task.wait(0.4); Toast.Visible = false; toastBusy = false
end

function runCommand(raw)
    raw = raw:gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
    if raw:sub(1,#PREFIX)~=PREFIX then return false end
    local body=raw:sub(#PREFIX+1); local parts={}
    for w in body:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(parts,w) end
    if #parts==0 then return false end
    local cn=parts[1]:lower(); local args={}
    for i=2,#parts do args[i-1]=parts[i] end
    local cmd=Commands[cn]
    if cmd then
        local ok,err=pcall(cmd,args)
        if not ok then notify("Error: "..tostring(err), Color3.fromRGB(255,100,100)) end
        if ok and SHOWOFF and not SILENT[cn] then flashAnnounce(LocalPlayer.Name.." used "..PREFIX..cn.." "..table.concat(args," ")) end
        return true
    else
        notify("Unknown '"..cn.."' — passing to Kohl's", Color3.fromRGB(255,200,100)); kohl(body); return true
    end
end

local function renderTab(id)
    for _, c in ipairs(Content:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end end
    for i, def in ipairs(CMD_DEFS[id] or {}) do
        local label, cmd, needsT, needsV, needsT2 = def[1], def[2], def[3], def[4], def[5]
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0,122,0,34); btn.LayoutOrder = i

        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230,240,255); btn.Text = label
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,7)
        local bs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); bs.Color = ACCENT2; bs.Thickness = 1; bs.Transparency = 0.6; bs.Parent = btn
        btn.Parent = Content
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local t = currentTarget; local v = currentValue
            local DESTRUCTIVE_GUI = {kill=true,explode=true,fire=true,rocket=true,lightning=true,meteor=true,void=true,freeze=true,jail=true,smoke=true,sparkles=true}
            if DESTRUCTIVE_GUI[cmd] and (t == "me" or t == "") then t = "others" end
            local s = PREFIX..cmd
            if needsT then s = s.." "..t end
            if needsT2 then s = s.." "..(v~="" and v or "me") end
            if needsV and v~="" then s = s.." "..v end
            if (cmd=="announce" or cmd=="hint" or cmd=="music" or cmd=="time" or cmd=="weather" or cmd=="gravity") and v~="" then s = PREFIX..cmd.." "..v end

task.spawn(function()
    local lastSafe = nil

        task.wait(0.5)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character

                end

                    root.Velocity = Vector3.new(); kohl("thaw "..LocalPlayer.Name)
                end
                if ANTI_FREEZE and (hum.WalkSpeed <= 1 or hum.PlatformStand) then

                    kohl("thaw "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("unjail "..LocalPlayer.Name)

                end
            end

        end
    end
end)

-- Anti-abuse: detect commands used on you via chat + auto-counter
local function counter(attacker, cmd, target)
    if not ANTI_ABUSE then return end
    local me = LocalPlayer.Name:lower()
    local dn = LocalPlayer.DisplayName:lower()
    local t = target:lower()
    if not (t:find(me,1,true) or t:find(dn,1,true) or t=="all" or t=="others") then return end
    notify(attacker.." used ;"..cmd.." on you! Countering...", Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80))
    local c = cmd:lower()
    if c:match("kick") or c:match("ban") or c:match("shutdown") then
        pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer) end)
    elseif c:match("kill") or c:match("explode") or c:match("rocket") or c:match("meteor") then
        kohl("god "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("forcefield "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("heal "..LocalPlayer.Name)
    elseif c:match("freeze") or c:match("jail") or c:match("sit") or c:match("ice") or c:match("cage") then
        kohl("thaw "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("unjail "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("speed "..LocalPlayer.Name.." 16")
    elseif c:match("invisible") then kohl("visible "..LocalPlayer.Name)
    elseif c:match("speed") or c:match("jump") then kohl("speed "..LocalPlayer.Name.." 16"); kohl("jump "..LocalPlayer.Name.." 50")
    elseif c:match("size") then kohl("size "..LocalPlayer.Name.." 1")
    elseif c:match("void") or c:match("fling") then kohl("thaw "..LocalPlayer.Name); kohl("visible "..LocalPlayer.Name) end
    for uid in pairs(protectedPlayers) do
        local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
        if p then kohl("god "..p.Name); kohl("heal "..p.Name); kohl("thaw "..p.Name); kohl("forcefield "..p.Name) end
    end
end
local function hookAbuse(p)
    p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
        if p == LocalPlayer then return end
        local cmd, target = msg:match("^[;!](%w+)%s+(.+)")
        if cmd and target then counter(p.Name, cmd, target:gsub("%s+","")) end
    end)
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookAbuse(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookAbuse)

-- Admin protection chat commands (;permadmin, ;keep, ;min, ;max, ;antiabuse, ;antis)
LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
    local lower = msg:lower()
    if lower:match("permadmin") then
        PERM_ADMIN = not PERM_ADMIN
        notify("PermAdmin: "..(PERM_ADMIN and "ON" or "OFF"), PERM_ADMIN and Color3.fromRGB(120,255,140) or Color3.fromRGB(255,200,100))
    elseif lower:match("^[;!]keep") then
        local name = msg:match("keep%s+(%S+)")
        if name then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Name:lower():find(name:lower(),1,true) or name:lower()=="all" then
                    protectedPlayers[p.UserId] = true
                    kohl("god "..p.Name); kohl("forcefield "..p.Name); kohl("heal "..p.Name)
                    notify("Kept: "..p.Name, Color3.fromRGB(120,255,140))
                end
            end
        end
    elseif lower:match("^[;!]min%s") then
        local name = msg:match("min%s+(%S+)"); if name then kohl("size "..name.." 0.3"); notify("Shrunk: "..name) end
    elseif lower:match("^[;!]max%s") then
        local name = msg:match("max%s+(%S+)"); if name then kohl("size "..name.." 3"); notify("Grew: "..name) end
    elseif lower:match("antiabuse") then
        ANTI_ABUSE = not ANTI_ABUSE; notify("Anti-abuse: "..tostring(ANTI_ABUSE))
    elseif lower:match("^[;!]antis") then
        notify("Void:"..tostring(ANTI_VOID).." Fling:"..tostring(ANTI_FLING).." Freeze:"..tostring(ANTI_FREEZE).." Kill:"..tostring(ANTI_KILL).." Abuse:"..tostring(ANTI_ABUSE).." PermAdmin:"..tostring(PERM_ADMIN))
    end
end)

local function setDanceMode(enabled, hum)
	local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
	if enabled then
		if not danceActive then
			danceActive = true
			if char then
				local animScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
				if animScript and animScript:IsA("LocalScript") and animScript.Enabled then
					disabledAnimateScript = animScript
					animScript.Enabled = false
				end
			end
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					if animator then
						for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
							track:Stop(0)
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	else
		if danceActive then
			danceActive = false
			if disabledAnimateScript and disabledAnimateScript.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					disabledAnimateScript.Enabled = true
				end)
			end
			disabledAnimateScript = nil

			if char then
				for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
						pcall(function()
							desc.Transform = CFrame.identity
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function stepProceduralDance(clockNow, hum)
	local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char or not hum then return end

	setDanceMode(true, hum)

	local beat = clockNow * 11
	local bounceY = math.abs(math.sin(beat)) * 0.65
	local swayX = math.sin(beat * 0.5) * 0.45
	local twistY = math.sin(beat) * 0.55
	local armWaveL = math.sin(beat) * 1.45 - 0.75
	local armWaveR = math.cos(beat) * 1.45 - 0.75
	local legKickL = math.sin(beat) * 0.75
	local legKickR = -math.sin(beat) * 0.75

	local function applyJoint(jointName, cf)
		local joint = char:FindFirstChild(jointName, true)
		if joint and joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
			joint.Transform = cf
		end
	end

	if hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		applyJoint("RootJoint", CFrame.new(swayX, bounceY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, twistY, math.sin(beat * 0.5) * 0.18))
		applyJoint("Left Shoulder", CFrame.new(0, 0.25, 0) * CFrame.Angles(armWaveL, 0, -0.45))
		applyJoint("Right Shoulder", CFrame.new(0, 0.25, 0) * CFrame.Angles(armWaveR, 0, 0.45))
		applyJoint("Left Hip", CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(legKickL, 0, -0.14))
		applyJoint("Right Hip", CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(legKickR, 0, 0.14))
		applyJoint("Neck", CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(beat * 2) * 0.16, -twistY * 0.7, math.cos(beat) * 0.2))
	else
		applyJoint("Root", CFrame.new(swayX, bounceY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, twistY, math.sin(beat * 0.5) * 0.16))
		applyJoint("Waist", CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(beat * 2) * 0.14, twistY * 0.65, math.cos(beat) * 0.16))

local function updateCameraDisco(clockNow)
	ensureCameraDiscoEffects(true)
	local idx = (math.floor(clockNow * 7) % #discoColors) + 1
	local nextIdx = (idx % #discoColors) + 1
	local alpha = (clockNow * 7) % 1
	local blended = discoColors[idx]:Lerp(discoColors[nextIdx], alpha)

	if discoColorEffect then
		discoColorEffect.TintColor = blended
		discoColorEffect.Saturation = 0.35 + math.sin(clockNow * 12) * 0.25
		discoColorEffect.Contrast = 0.1 + math.abs(math.cos(clockNow * 10)) * 0.18
	end
	if discoBloomEffect then
		discoBloomEffect.Intensity = 0.55 + math.abs(math.sin(clockNow * 9)) * 0.55
	end
end

local CORNER_HIT_SIZE = 24
local dragging = false
local resizing = false
local activeCorner = nil
local activeInput = nil
local dragStartPos = Vector2.zero
local lastDragClock = 0
local iceSlideVel = Vector2.zero

local currentPosOffset = Vector2.new(MainFrame.Position.X.Offset, MainFrame.Position.Y.Offset)
local currentPosScale = Vector2.new(MainFrame.Position.X.Scale, MainFrame.Position.Y.Scale)
local targetPosOffset = currentPosOffset

local currentWidth = BASE_WIDTH
local currentHeight = BASE_HEIGHT

local function detectCorner(screenPos)
	local absPos = MainFrame.AbsolutePosition
	local absSize = MainFrame.AbsoluteSize
	local left = absPos.X
	local right = absPos.X + absSize.X
	local top = absPos.Y
	local bottom = absPos.Y + absSize.Y

	local nearLeft = math.abs(screenPos.X - left) <= CORNER_HIT_SIZE
	local nearRight = math.abs(screenPos.X - right) <= CORNER_HIT_SIZE
	local nearTop = math.abs(screenPos.Y - top) <= CORNER_HIT_SIZE
	local nearBottom = math.abs(screenPos.Y - bottom) <= CORNER_HIT_SIZE

	if nearTop and nearLeft then return "TopLeft" end
	if nearTop and nearRight then return "TopRight" end
	if nearBottom and nearLeft then return "BottomLeft" end
	if nearBottom and nearRight then return "BottomRight" end
	return nil
end

local function applyDirectionalMoveImpulse(delta)
	if resizing then return end
	bounceOffsetVel += Vector2.new(delta.X * 18, delta.Y * 18)
	bounceRotVel += math.clamp(delta.X * 1.35, -36, 36)
	local dirRatioX = (math.abs(delta.X) - math.abs(delta.Y))
	bounceStretchXVel += math.clamp(dirRatioX * 0.085, -2.4, 2.4)
	bounceScaleVel += math.clamp(delta.Magnitude * 0.04, -1.8, 2.4)
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local pos2 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local corner = detectCorner(pos2)

		activeInput = input
		dragStartPos = pos2
		lastDragClock = os.clock()
		iceSlideVel = Vector2.zero

		if corner then
			resizing = true
			dragging = false
			activeCorner = corner
		else
			dragging = true
			resizing = false
			activeCorner = nil
			bounceScaleVel += 2.2
		end

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and input == activeInput then
				if dragging then
					bounceOffsetVel += bounceOffset * 3.5 + (iceSlideVel * 0.04)
				end
				dragging = false
				resizing = false
				activeCorner = nil
				activeInput = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not activeInput or input ~= activeInput then return end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end

	local now = os.clock()
	local dtDrag = math.max(now - lastDragClock, 1 / 240)
	lastDragClock = now

	local pos2 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
	local delta = pos2 - dragStartPos
	dragStartPos = pos2

	if resizing and activeCorner then
		local dx = delta.X
		local dy = delta.Y

		local newW = currentWidth
		local newH = currentHeight
		local posShiftX = 0
		local posShiftY = 0

		if activeCorner == "BottomRight" then
			newW = math.clamp(currentWidth + dx, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
			newH = math.clamp(currentHeight + dy, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT)
		elseif activeCorner == "BottomLeft" then
			newW = math.clamp(currentWidth - dx, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
			newH = math.clamp(currentHeight + dy, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT)
			posShiftX = currentWidth - newW
		elseif activeCorner == "TopRight" then
			newW = math.clamp(currentWidth + dx, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
			newH = math.clamp(currentHeight - dy, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT)
			posShiftY = currentHeight - newH
		elseif activeCorner == "TopLeft" then
			newW = math.clamp(currentWidth - dx, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH)
			newH = math.clamp(currentHeight - dy, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT)
			posShiftX = currentWidth - newW
			posShiftY = currentHeight - newH
		end

		currentWidth = newW
		currentHeight = newH
		targetPosOffset += Vector2.new(posShiftX, posShiftY)
		currentPosOffset = targetPosOffset
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, currentWidth, 0, currentHeight)
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(currentPosScale.X, currentPosOffset.X, currentPosScale.Y, currentPosOffset.Y)
	elseif dragging then
		targetPosOffset += delta
		currentPosOffset = targetPosOffset

		local instVel = (delta / dtDrag) * ICE_THROW_BOOST
		if instVel.Magnitude > ICE_MAX_THROW_SPEED then
			instVel = instVel.Unit * ICE_MAX_THROW_SPEED
		end
		iceSlideVel = iceSlideVel:Lerp(instVel, 0.55)

		applyDirectionalMoveImpulse(delta)
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not ScreenGui.Parent then return end

	local clampedDt = math.min(dt, 0.05)
	local clockNow = os.clock()
	local utcTable, nowUtc = getCurrentUtcTableAndTimestamp()
	local diff = targetUtcTimestamp - nowUtc

	if not dragging and not resizing and iceSlideVel.Magnitude > 0.2 then
		targetPosOffset += iceSlideVel * clampedDt
		currentPosOffset = targetPosOffset
		iceSlideVel = iceSlideVel * math.exp(-ICE_FRICTION_DAMPING * clampedDt)

		local viewSize = ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
		if viewSize.X > 0 and viewSize.Y > 0 then
			local baseX = viewSize.X * currentPosScale.X
			local baseY = viewSize.Y * currentPosScale.Y
			local minX = -baseX + 20
			local maxX = viewSize.X - baseX - currentWidth - 20
			local minY = -baseY + 20
			local maxY = viewSize.Y - baseY - currentHeight - 20

			if currentPosOffset.X < minX then
				currentPosOffset = Vector2.new(minX, currentPosOffset.Y)
				targetPosOffset = currentPosOffset
				iceSlideVel = Vector2.new(-iceSlideVel.X * 0.45, iceSlideVel.Y)
				bounceRotVel += 12
			elseif currentPosOffset.X > maxX then
				currentPosOffset = Vector2.new(maxX, currentPosOffset.Y)
				targetPosOffset = currentPosOffset
				iceSlideVel = Vector2.new(-iceSlideVel.X * 0.45, iceSlideVel.Y)
				bounceRotVel -= 12
			end

			if currentPosOffset.Y < minY then
				currentPosOffset = Vector2.new(currentPosOffset.X, minY)
				targetPosOffset = currentPosOffset
				iceSlideVel = Vector2.new(iceSlideVel.X, -iceSlideVel.Y * 0.45)
				bounceScaleVel += 2.5
			elseif currentPosOffset.Y > maxY then
				currentPosOffset = Vector2.new(currentPosOffset.X, maxY)
				targetPosOffset = currentPosOffset
				iceSlideVel = Vector2.new(iceSlideVel.X, -iceSlideVel.Y * 0.45)
				bounceScaleVel += 2.5
			end
		end
	end

	local isCelebrating = false
	if diff <= 0 then
		if celebrationUntil == 0 then
			triggerCelebrationNow()
		end

		if clockNow < celebrationUntil then
			isCelebrating = true
		else
			celebrationUntil = 0
			activeTargetYear, targetUtcTimestamp = getNextNewYearTarget(utcTable)
			applyYearTheme(activeTargetYear)
			diff = math.max(0, targetUtcTimestamp - nowUtc)
		end
	elseif celebrationUntil > 0 then
		if clockNow < celebrationUntil then
			isCelebrating = true
		else
			celebrationUntil = 0
		end
	end

	if wasCelebrating and not isCelebrating then
		clearPartyEffects(true)
	end
	wasCelebrating = isCelebrating

	local elapsedParty = isCelebrating and (clockNow - celebrationStartClock) or 0
	local partyShakeVec = Vector2.zero
	local partyRot = 0
	local statusText = nil

	if isCelebrating then
		local hum, root = getHumanoidAndRoot()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if hum then
			stepProceduralDance(clockNow, hum)
		end

		if cam then
			if elapsedParty < 3.0 then
				tryTriggerDeviceVibration()
				cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7
				) * CFrame.Angles(
					math.sin(clockNow * 70) * 0.045,
					math.cos(clockNow * 65) * 0.045,
					math.sin(clockNow * 80) * 0.05
				)
				statusText = "VIOLENT CAMERA SHAKE!"
			else
				updateCameraDisco(clockNow)
			end
		end

		if root then
			local spinSpeed = (elapsedParty < 3) and 10 or 18
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, spinSpeed * clampedDt, 0)
		end

		if hum then
			if elapsedParty >= 3 then
				hum.WalkSpeed = HIGH_SPEED_VALUE
			elseif originalWalkSpeed then
				hum.WalkSpeed = math.max(originalWalkSpeed, 40)
			end
		end

		if elapsedParty >= 6.5 then
			if not isSpaceFlightActive then
				setSpaceFlight(true)
			end
			if hum and root and cam and flyBv and flyBg then
				local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, SPACE_LAUNCH_UP_SPEED, 0)
				local userInputDir = Vector3.zero
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then userInputDir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then userInputDir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then userInputDir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then userInputDir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then userInputDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then userInputDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

				if userInputDir.Magnitude > 0 then
					moveDir = userInputDir.Unit * SPACE_FLY_SPEED
				end
				flyBv.Velocity = moveDir
				flyBg.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 15 * clampedDt, 0)
			end
		end

		if not statusText then
			if elapsedParty < 3 then
				statusText = "DANCING + LOUD SIREN!"
			elseif elapsedParty < 6.5 then
				statusText = string.format("SPEED %d+ | DANCE", HIGH_SPEED_VALUE)
			elseif elapsedParty < 9 then
				statusText = "SPACE DANCE PARTY!"
			else
				statusText = "5X DISCO DANCE PARTY!"
			end
		end

		if elapsedParty >= 9 then
			tryTriggerDeviceVibration()
			partyShakeVec = Vector2.new(
				math.sin(clockNow * 58) * 11,
				math.cos(clockNow * 64) * 9.5
			)
			partyRot = math.sin(clockNow * 48) * 6.5
		else
			partyShakeVec = Vector2.new(
				math.sin(clockNow * 24) * 3.5,
				math.cos(clockNow * 22) * 3
			)
			partyRot = math.sin(clockNow * 18) * 2.2
		end

		partySparkTimer += clampedDt * 5
		if partySparkTimer >= 0.16 then
			partySparkTimer = 0
			spawnPartyFireworkBurst(5)
		end

		sirenSoundTimer += clampedDt
		if sirenSoundTimer >= 0.85 then
			sirenSoundTimer = 0
			pcall(function()
				if UltraLoudSiren and UltraLoudSiren.Parent then
					UltraLoudSiren.SoundId = ULTRA_SIREN_SOUND_IDS[sirenSoundIndex]
					sirenSoundIndex = (sirenSoundIndex % #ULTRA_SIREN_SOUND_IDS) + 1
					UltraLoudSiren.Volume = 10
					UltraLoudSiren.PlaybackSpeed = 1.05 + (math.random() * 0.25)
					UltraLoudSiren:Play()
				end
			end)
		end

		fireSoundTimer += clampedDt
		if fireSoundTimer >= 0.75 then
			fireSoundTimer = 0
			pcall(function()
				if FireSound and FireSound.Parent then
					FireSound.SoundId = FIRE_SOUND_IDS[fireSoundIndex]
					fireSoundIndex = (fireSoundIndex % #FIRE_SOUND_IDS) + 1
					FireSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.95 + (math.random() * 0.25)
					FireSound:Play()
				end
			end)
		end

		hornSoundTimer += clampedDt
		if hornSoundTimer >= 2.6 then
			hornSoundTimer = 0
			pcall(function()
				if HornSound and HornSound.Parent then
					HornSound.SoundId = HORN_SOUND_IDS[hornSoundIndex]
					hornSoundIndex = (hornSoundIndex % #HORN_SOUND_IDS) + 1
					HornSound:Play()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local closeSize = math.clamp(math.min(currentWidth, currentHeight) * 0.2, 20, 44)
	CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(closeSize, closeSize)
	CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(closeSize + 8), 0, 8)
	TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(closeSize + 20), 0, 35)

	local stiffness = 115
	local damping = 9.5

	local offsetForce = (-bounceOffset * stiffness) - (bounceOffsetVel * damping)
	bounceOffsetVel += offsetForce * clampedDt
	bounceOffset = Vector2.new(
		math.clamp(bounceOffset.X + bounceOffsetVel.X * clampedDt, -26, 26),
		math.clamp(bounceOffset.Y + bounceOffsetVel.Y * clampedDt, -26, 26)
	)

	local rotForce = (-bounceRot * stiffness) - (bounceRotVel * damping)
	bounceRotVel += rotForce * clampedDt
	bounceRot = math.clamp(bounceRot + bounceRotVel * clampedDt, -13, 13)

	local scaleForce = ((1 - bounceScale) * (stiffness * 1.05)) - (bounceScaleVel * damping)
	bounceScaleVel += scaleForce * clampedDt
	bounceScale = math.clamp(bounceScale + bounceScaleVel * clampedDt, 0.88, 1.15)

	local stretchForce = (-bounceStretchX * (stiffness * 1.1)) - (bounceStretchXVel * damping)
	bounceStretchXVel += stretchForce * clampedDt
	bounceStretchX = math.clamp(bounceStretchX + bounceStretchXVel * clampedDt, -0.1, 0.1)

	local activeW = currentWidth
	local activeH = currentHeight

	if resizing then
		bounceOffset = Vector2.zero
		bounceOffsetVel = Vector2.zero
		bounceRot = 0
		bounceRotVel = 0
		bounceScale = 1
		bounceScaleVel = 0
		bounceStretchX = 0
		bounceStretchXVel = 0
		MainFrame.Rotation = 0
		FrameScale.Scale = 1
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, activeW, 0, activeH)
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(currentPosScale.X, currentPosOffset.X, currentPosScale.Y, currentPosOffset.Y)
	else
		activeW = currentWidth * (1 + bounceStretchX)
		activeH = currentHeight * (1 - bounceStretchX * 0.65)
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			currentPosScale.X,
			currentPosOffset.X + bounceOffset.X + partyShakeVec.X,
			currentPosScale.Y,
			currentPosOffset.Y + bounceOffset.Y + partyShakeVec.Y
		)
		MainFrame.Rotation = bounceRot + partyRot
		FrameScale.Scale = bounceScale
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, activeW, 0, activeH)
	end

	local currentPos = MainFrame.AbsolutePosition
	local delta = currentPos - lastPos
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	local speed = dist / math.max(clampedDt, 1 / 240)

	local rawShake = math.clamp(speed / 1350, 0, 1)
	if isCelebrating then
		rawShake = math.max(rawShake, (elapsedParty >= 9) and 1.0 or 0.75)
	end
	shakeIntensity += (rawShake - shakeIntensity) * math.min(1, clampedDt * 14)

	local rotSpeed = 75 + (shakeIntensity * 280)
	rotation = (rotation + rotSpeed * clampedDt) % 360
	UIGradient.Rotation = rotation
	TrueGoldGradient.Rotation = 25 + math.sin(clockNow * 1.8) * 16

	textSweepPhase = (textSweepPhase + (1.6 + shakeIntensity * 6.5) * clampedDt) % (math.pi * 2)
	local sweepX = math.sin(textSweepPhase) * 0.65
	local shimmerPulse = (math.sin(clockNow * 10) * 0.5 + 0.5) * (0.3 + shakeIntensity * 0.7)

	titleGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(sweepX, 0)
	timerGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(-sweepX, 0)
	titleGrad.Rotation = -16 + math.sin(clockNow * 4) * 12
	timerGrad.Rotation = 16 + math.cos(clockNow * 4) * 12

	titleStroke.Thickness = 1.5 + (shakeIntensity * 1.0) + (shimmerPulse * 0.4)
	timerStroke.Thickness = 2.0 + (shakeIntensity * 1.1) + (shimmerPulse * 0.4)
	titleStroke.Transparency = math.clamp(0.18 - (shakeIntensity * 0.12), 0.05, 0.4)
	timerStroke.Transparency = math.clamp(0.16 - (shakeIntensity * 0.12), 0.05, 0.4)
	titleStrokeGrad.Rotation = (clockNow * (140 + shakeIntensity * 420)) % 360
	timerStrokeGrad.Rotation = -(clockNow * (140 + shakeIntensity * 420)) % 360

	gleamRotation = -35 + math.sin(clockNow * 2.4) * 28 + (shakeIntensity * 45)
	GleamGradient.Rotation = gleamRotation
	GoldGleamOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.84 - (shakeIntensity * 0.56), 0.25, 0.9)

	local shadowShiftX = 8 - (bounceOffset.X * 0.65) + (shakeIntensity * 5)
	local shadowShiftY = 12 - (bounceOffset.Y * 0.65) + (shakeIntensity * 7)
	local expandScale = 1 + (shakeIntensity * 0.14)

	ShadowGroup.Size = UDim2.new(0, activeW, 0, activeH)
	ShadowGroup.Position = UDim2.new(
		currentPosScale.X,
		(currentPosOffset.X + bounceOffset.X + partyShakeVec.X) + shadowShiftX,
		currentPosScale.Y,
		(currentPosOffset.Y + bounceOffset.Y + partyShakeVec.Y) + shadowShiftY
	)
	ShadowGroup.Rotation = MainFrame.Rotation
	ShadowScale.Scale = FrameScale.Scale * expandScale

	for _, entry in ipairs(shadowLayers) do
		local shimmer = (math.sin(clockNow * 8.0 + entry.phase) * 0.5 + 0.5) * shakeIntensity
		local currentTrans = entry.idleTrans + ((entry.activeTrans - entry.idleTrans) * shakeIntensity) - (shimmer * entry.pulseAmp)
		entry.frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(currentTrans, 0.05, 0.99)
		entry.grad.Rotation = (clockNow * (85 + shakeIntensity * 320) + entry.phase * 45) % 360
	end

	dripSpawnTimer += clampedDt * (1 + shakeIntensity * 1.4)
	if dripSpawnTimer >= 0.42 then
		dripSpawnTimer = 0
		spawnSlowGoldDrip()
	end

	for i = #activeDrips, 1, -1 do
		local d = activeDrips[i]
		d.age += clampedDt
		local progress = math.clamp(d.age / d.maxAge, 0, 1)

		d.y += d.vy * clampedDt
		d.vy += 12 * clampedDt
		d.length = math.min(d.maxLength, d.baseWidth + progress * (d.maxLength - d.baseWidth))
		local currentW = math.max(2, d.baseWidth * (1 - progress * 0.55))

		d.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(d.x, d.y)
		d.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(currentW, d.length)
		d.frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.08 + (progress ^ 1.3) * 0.92, 0, 1)

		if d.age >= d.maxAge then
			if d.frame then
				d.frame:Destroy()
			end
			table.remove(activeDrips, i)
		end
	end

	for i = #partySparks, 1, -1 do
		local sp = partySparks[i]
		sp.age += clampedDt
		local p = math.clamp(sp.age / sp.maxAge, 0, 1)
		sp.x += sp.vx * clampedDt
		sp.y += sp.vy * clampedDt
		sp.vy += 220 * clampedDt
		sp.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.x, sp.y)
		sp.frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(p ^ 1.2, 0, 1)
		if sp.age >= sp.maxAge then
			if sp.frame then sp.frame:Destroy() end
			table.remove(partySparks, i)
		end
	end

	UIStroke.Thickness = 2.6 + (shakeIntensity * 1.9)
	lastPos = currentPos

	if isCelebrating then
		TitleLabel.Text = string.format("%d DANCE PARTY!", activeTargetYear)
		TimerLabel.Text = statusText or string.format("%d DANCE!", activeTargetYear)
	elseif diff > 0 then
		TitleLabel.Text = string.format("%d Countdown", activeTargetYear)
		if lastTickSecond ~= nowUtc then
			lastTickSecond = nowUtc
			pcall(function()
				if TickSound and TickSound.Parent then
					TickSound.PlaybackSpeed = (diff % 2 == 0) and 1.04 or 0.98
					TickSound:Play()
				end
			end)
		end

		local days = math.floor(diff / 86400)
		local hours = math.floor((diff % 86400) / 3600)
		local minutes = math.floor((diff % 3600) / 60)
		local seconds = diff % 60

		TimerLabel.Text = string.format("%02dD : %02dH : %02dM : %02dS", days, hours, minutes, seconds)
	end
end)

scripts.author: w4zekidd
scripts.summary: This Is A C00l Gojo Morph that comes with two outfits and the hollow purple ability
scripts.code:
local gojoShiiPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local hollowpurplehitstuff = 3
local gojoShiiChar = gojoShiiPlayer.Character or gojoShiiPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
if not gojoShiiChar then return end
local gojoShiiReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local gojoShiiRequestCommand = gojoShiiReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
pcall(function()
	gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";r6 me")
end)
task.wait(0.6)
local function getF3XTool()
	local bp = gojoShiiPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if bp then
		for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
			if tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then return tool end
		end
	end
	if gojoShiiChar then
		for _, tool in ipairs(gojoShiiChar:GetChildren()) do
			if tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then return tool end
		end
	end
	for _, v in ipairs(gojoShiiPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then return v.Parent end
	end
	for _, v in ipairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then return v.Parent end
	end
	return nil
end
local gojoShiiF3XTool = getF3XTool()
if not gojoShiiF3XTool then
	pcall(function()
		gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";btools me")
	end)
	for _ = 1, 30 do
		task.wait(0.1)
		gojoShiiF3XTool = getF3XTool()
		if gojoShiiF3XTool then break end
	end
end
if not gojoShiiF3XTool then return end
gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";btools me")
task.wait(0.2)
gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";clearAccessories")
task.wait(0.2)
gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";hat me 71461450016019")
task.wait(0.2)
gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";shirt me 12568250741")
task.wait(0.2)
gojoShiiRequestCommand:InvokeServer(";pants me 12568249478")
local gojoShiiSkin = Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 189)
local gojoShiiRemote = gojoShiiF3XTool.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
local function _(args)
	return gojoShiiRemote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end
local function CreatePart(cf, parent, typ)
	return _({"CreatePart", typ or "Ball", cf, parent})
end
local function SetName(part, name)
	_({"SetName", {part}, name})
end
local function MovePart(part, cf)
	pcall(function()
		gojoShiiRemote:InvokeServer("SyncMove", {{Part = part, CFrame = cf}})
	end)
end
local function Resize(part, size, cf)
	_({"SyncResize", {{Part = part, CFrame = cf, Size = size}}})
end
local function Color(part, color)
	_({"SyncColor", {{Part = part, Color = color, UnionColoring = false}}})
end
local function Destroy(part)
	pcall(function() _({"Remove", {part}}) end)
end
local function SetAnchor(boolean, part)
	_({"SyncAnchor", {{Part = part, Anchored = boolean}}})
end
local function SetCollision(part, boolean)
	_({"SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = boolean}}})
end
local function mat(part, material)
	_({"SyncMaterial", {{Part = part, Material = material}}})
end
local function SetSkinColor()
	local gojoShiiBodyParts = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(gojoShiiChar:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and (
			v.Name == "Head"
			or v.Name == "Torso"
			or v.Name == "UpperTorso"
			or v.Name == "LowerTorso"
			or v.Name == "Left Arm"
			or v.Name == "Right Arm"
			or v.Name == "LeftUpperArm"
			or v.Name == "LeftLowerArm"
			or v.Name == "LeftHand"
			or v.Name == "RightUpperArm"
			or v.Name == "RightLowerArm"
			or v.Name == "RightHand"
			or v.Name == "Left Leg"
			or v.Name == "Right Leg"
			or v.Name == "LeftUpperLeg"
			or v.Name == "LeftLowerLeg"
			or v.Name == "LeftFoot"
			or v.Name == "RightUpperLeg"
			or v.Name == "RightLowerLeg"
			or v.Name == "RightFoot"
		) then
			table.insert(gojoShiiBodyParts, {Part = v, Color = gojoShiiSkin, UnionColoring = false})
		end
	end
	if #gojoShiiBodyParts > 0 then
		for i = 1, #gojoShiiBodyParts, 30 do
			local chunk = {}
			for j = i, math.min(i + 29, #gojoShiiBodyParts) do
				table.insert(chunk, gojoShiiBodyParts[j])
			end
			pcall(function()
				gojoShiiRemote:InvokeServer("SyncColor", chunk)
			end)
		end
	end
end
local function ApplyGojoSkin()
	gojoShiiChar = gojoShiiPlayer.Character or gojoShiiPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local bodyColors = gojoShiiChar and gojoShiiChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
	if bodyColors then
		bodyColors.HeadColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
		bodyColors.LeftArmColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
		bodyColors.RightArmColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
		bodyColors.LeftLegColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
		bodyColors.RightLegColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
		bodyColors.TorsoColor3 = gojoShiiSkin
	end
	SetSkinColor()
end
ApplyGojoSkin()
task.delay(0.75, ApplyGojoSkin)
task.delay(1.5, ApplyGojoSkin)
local gojoShiiHollowPurpleMesh = "115588380145455"
local gojoShiiHollowPurpleTexture = "88842645797136"
local function AddMesh(part)
	_({"CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}}})
end
local function SetMesh(part, meshId, textureId)
	_({"SyncMesh", {{
		Part = part,
		MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh,
		MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. meshId,
		TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. textureId
	}}})
end
local function MeshScale(part, scale)
	_({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = scale}}})
end
local function burn(part)
	_({"CreateDecorations", {{Part = part, DecorationsType = "Fire"}}})
end
local function dih(part, size, heat, col, col2)
	_({"SyncDecorate", {{
		Part = part,
		DecorationType = "Fire",
		Size = size,
		Heat = heat,
		Color = col,
		SecondaryColor = col2
	}}})
end
local function Smoke(part)
	_({"CreateDecorations", {{Part = part, DecorationsType = "Smoke"}}})
end
local function smok(part, col)
	_({"SyncDecorate", {{Part = part, DecorationsType = "Smoke", Color = col}}})
end
local function getGojoShiiPlayerFloorParts()
	local protected = {}
	if not gojoShiiChar or not gojoShiiChar.Parent then return protected end
	local root = gojoShiiChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return protected end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {gojoShiiChar}

	local offsets = {
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(2.5, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(-2.5, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 2.5),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, -2.5),
		Vector3.new(2.5, 0, 2.5),
		Vector3.new(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
		Vector3.new(2.5, 0, -2.5),
		Vector3.new(-2.5, 0, -2.5)
	}

	for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
		local result = workspace:Raycast(
			root.Position + offset + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, -100, 0),
			params
		)
		if result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			protected[result.Instance] = true
		end
	end

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {gojoShiiChar}

	local nearby = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
		CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)),
		Vector3.new(7, 6, 7),
		overlapParams
	)

	for _, part in ipairs(nearby) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored and not part:IsDescendantOf(gojoShiiChar) then
			local localPos = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
			local topY = part.Size.Y / 2
			if math.abs(localPos.X) <= part.Size.X / 2 + 0.5
				and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= part.Size.Z / 2 + 0.5
				and localPos.Y >= topY - 1
				and localPos.Y <= topY + 8 then
				protected[part] = true
			end
		end
	end

	return protected
end

local function unanchorNear(pos, range)
	local batch = {}
	local playerFloorParts = getGojoShiiPlayerFloorParts()

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {gojoShiiChar}

	local nearbyParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos, range, overlapParams)

	for _, v in ipairs(nearbyParts) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Anchored and not v:IsA("Terrain") then
			local n = v.Name
			local model = v:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

			local isCharacterPart =
				v:IsDescendantOf(gojoShiiChar)
				or (model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil)

			local protectedByPlayerFloor = playerFloorParts[v] == true

			local protectedName =
				n == "HollowPurple"
				or n == "HollowPurpleCore"
				or n == "specialPart"

			if not isCharacterPart
				and not protectedByPlayerFloor
				and not protectedName then
				table.insert(batch, v)
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #batch, 30 do
		local chunk = {}

if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

scripts.title: Silent Aim + Outline ESP
scripts.author: huynhminhtan362
scripts.summary: Silent Aim: Directly hooks require(Viewmodel) (no __namecall hook), automatically redirecting shots to the player closest to the center of your screen. Outline ESP: Clean outline-only glow through walls (Highlight with no inner fill), au…
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Viewmodel = require(ReplicatedStorage.BodycamGuns.Viewmodel)
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local EspFolder = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui

local Settings = {
	Enabled = true,
	TargetPart = "Head",
	HitChance = 100,
	ESPEnabled = true,
	ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
}

local otherPlayers = {}
local highlights = {}
local charConnections = {}

local function getHighlight(player)
	local hl = highlights[player]
	if not hl then
		hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.FillTransparency = 1
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Enabled = false
		hl.Parent = EspFolder
		highlights[player] = hl
	end
	return hl
end

local function bindCharacter(player, char)
	if charConnections[player] then
		charConnections[player]:Disconnect()
		charConnections[player] = nil
	end

	local hl = getHighlight(player)
	if not char then
		hl.Adornee = nil
		hl.Enabled = false
		return
	end

	hl.Adornee = char
	hl.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if hum then
		hl.Enabled = Settings.ESPEnabled and hum.Health > 0
		charConnections[player] = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
			hl.Enabled = Settings.ESPEnabled and hp > 0
		end)
	else
		hl.Enabled = Settings.ESPEnabled
	end
end

local playerConnections = {}

local function setupPlayer(player)
	if player == LocalPlayer or playerConnections[player] then return end
	if player.Character then
		bindCharacter(player, player.Character)
	end
	playerConnections[player] = {
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			bindCharacter(player, char)
		end),
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
			bindCharacter(player, nil)
		end)
	}
end

local function cleanupPlayer(player)
	if charConnections[player] then
		charConnections[player]:Disconnect()
		charConnections[player] = nil
	end
	if playerConnections[player] then
		for _, conn in playerConnections[player] do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		playerConnections[player] = nil
	end
	if highlights[player] then
		highlights[player]:Destroy()
		highlights[player] = nil
	end
end

local function refreshPlayers()
	table.clear(otherPlayers)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer then
			table.insert(otherPlayers, player)
			setupPlayer(player)
		end
	end
end

refreshPlayers()
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshPlayers)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	cleanupPlayer(player)
	task.defer(refreshPlayers)
end)

workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
	Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
end)

local function getClosestToCenter()
	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
	local cx = viewport.X * 0.5
	local cy = viewport.Y * 0.5
	local closestPart = nil
	local shortestDistSq = math.huge

	for _, player in otherPlayers do
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then continue end

		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end

		local part = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.TargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not part then continue end

		local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if not onScreen then continue end

		local dx = screenPos.X - cx
		local dy = screenPos.Y - cy
		local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
		if distSq < shortestDistSq then
			shortestDistSq = distSq
			closestPart = part
		end
	end

	return closestPart
end

local savedCF = nil
local function restoreCamera()
	if savedCF then
		Camera.CFrame = savedCF
		savedCF = nil
	end
end

local oldIsAiming = Viewmodel.IsAiming
function Viewmodel:IsAiming()
	if Settings.Enabled and (Settings.HitChance >= 100 or math.random(1, 100) <= Settings.HitChance) then
		local oldCF = Camera.CFrame
		local targetPart = getClosestToCenter()
		if targetPart then
			savedCF = oldCF
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(oldCF.Position, targetPart.Position)
			task.defer(restoreCamera)
		end
	end
	return oldIsAiming(self)
end

scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: illegal soccer / Illegal Soccer : silent aim infinite stamina tackle aim perfect charge keyless open source chukunhax
scripts.code:
local rs, plrs, ws = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("Workspace")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer

local chukunhax = {
	silent = true,
	hitchance = 80,
	corner = 78,
	spread = 1.4,
	perfectcharge = true,
	tackleaim = true,
	stamina = true,
}

local function mod(...)
	local n = rs
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do n = n and n:FindFirstChild(v) end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, n)
	return ok and m or nil
end

local proto = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionRemoteProtocol")
local cmds = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionCommands")
local sprint = mod("Modules", "Actions", "Sprint")
local teams = mod("Client", "Gameplay", "ActorTeams")
local match = mod("Modules", "Gameplay", "MatchSettings")

local function getroot(c)
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function goals()
	local d = ws:FindFirstChild("Map") and ws.Map:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local a, b = d and d:FindFirstChild("Team1"), d and d:FindFirstChild("Team2")
	return a and a:FindFirstChild("Goal"), b and b:FindFirstChild("Goal")
end

local function enemygoal()
	local a, b = goals()
	if not (a and b) then return a or b end
	local ok, mine = pcall(teams.GetCharacterTeamName, lp.Character)
	local ok2, opp = ok and pcall(match.GetOpposingTeamName, mine)
	if ok2 and opp == "Team1" then return a end
	if ok2 and opp == "Team2" then return b end
	local r = getroot(lp.Character)
	if not r then return a end
	return (a.Position - r.Position).Magnitude > (b.Position - r.Position).Magnitude and a or b
end

local function keeper(goal)
	local best, dist = nil, 1e9
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			local d = (r.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = r, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function spot(goal)
	local side = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
	local k = keeper(goal)
	if k then side = goal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(k.Position).X > 0 and -1 or 1 end
	local x = side * goal.Size.X / 2 * (chukunhax.corner / 100)
	local y = goal.Size.Y / 2 * 0.8
	local jx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * chukunhax.spread
	local jy = (math.random() - 0.5) * chukunhax.spread
	return (goal.CFrame * CFrame.new(x + jx, y + jy, 0)).Position
end

local function isshot(c)
	if c.Mode == "Volley" then return true end
	if cmds and typeof(cmds.IsVolley) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(cmds.IsVolley, c)
		if ok and v then return true end
	end
	return c.PassType == "Shot"
end

local function closest()
	local me = getroot(lp.Character)
	local best, dist = nil, 25
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r and me then
			local d = (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function aimat(c, pos)
	local aim = c.AimDirection
	local has = typeof(aim) == "table"
	local origin = has and aim.Origin
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
		local r = getroot(lp.Character)
		origin = r and r.Position
	end
	if not origin or (pos - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	local dir = (pos - origin).Unit
	if has then
		aim.TargetPosition = pos
		aim.Direction = dir
	end
	c.TargetPosition = pos
	local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0 then c.KickDirection = flat.Unit end
end

local function edit(c)
	if chukunhax.perfectcharge and c.MaximumChargeSeconds then
		c.ChargeSeconds = c.MaximumChargeSeconds
	end
	if chukunhax.silent and isshot(c) and math.random(100) <= chukunhax.hitchance then
		local g = enemygoal()
		if g then aimat(c, spot(g)) end
	end
	if chukunhax.tackleaim and cmds and c.Kind == cmds.Kinds.Tackle and typeof(c.AimDirection) == "table" then
		local p = closest()
		local r = p and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			c.AimDirection.ClientHit = { Kind = "Player", UserId = p.UserId }
			c.TargetUserId = p.UserId
			aimat(c, r.Position)
		end
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "Send", "Start", "Update", "Release" }) do
	local og = proto[name]
	if typeof(og) == "function" then
		proto[name] = function(c, ...)
			if typeof(c) == "table" then pcall(edit, c) end
			return og(c, ...)
		end
	end
end

if chukunhax.stamina and sprint and sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina then
	pcall(sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina, lp, "hax", true)
end

scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: voxel wars fps silent aim
scripts.code:
local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lp, cam = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = { fov = 160, hitChance = 85, headChance = 55, wallcheck = true, players = true, bots = true }

local FIRE = {}
for _, n in ipairs({ "FireRifle", "FireSMG", "FireLMG", "FirePistol", "FireDMR", "FireSniper", "FireShotgun" }) do
	local r = RS.Voxel.Remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
	if r then FIRE[r] = n end
end
local Ballistics = require(RS.Voxel.Ballistics)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function alive(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
end

local function pick()
	local center, best, bestDist = cam.ViewportSize / 2, nil, CFG.fov
	local myTeam = tostring(lp.Team)
	local function consider(model)
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root or not alive(model) then return end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
		if not on then return end
		local d = (Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if d >= bestDist then return end
		if CFG.wallcheck then
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, model }
			if workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, root.Position - cam.CFrame.Position, params) then return end
		end
		best, bestDist = model, d
	end
	if CFG.players then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl ~= lp and pl.Character and (pl.Team == nil or pl.Team ~= lp.Team) then consider(pl.Character) end
		end
	end
	local rigs = CFG.bots and workspace:FindFirstChild("BotRigs")
	if rigs then
		for _, m in ipairs(rigs:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Team") ~= myTeam then consider(m) end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rewrite(name, a)
	local muzzle = a[1]
	if typeof(muzzle) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(a[2]) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	if math.random(100) > CFG.hitChance then return end
	local model = pick()
	if not model then return end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(math.random(100) <= CFG.headChance and "Head" or "UpperTorso")
	if not part then return end

	local speed, arc = Ballistics.SPEED or 1700, nil
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		speed = Ballistics.RIFLE_SPEED * ((tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("GsVelocity"))) or 1)
		arc = Ballistics.RIFLE_ARC
	end

	local point = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12)) / 100
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local dist = (point - muzzle).Magnitude
		local ok, t = pcall(Ballistics.flightTime, dist, speed, arc)
		point += root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * (ok and t or dist / speed)
	end

	local plain = (point - muzzle).Unit
	local aim = plain
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local ok, v = pcall(Ballistics.launch, muzzle, point, speed, arc)
		if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 0.5 then aim = v.Unit end
	end

	if name == "FireShotgun" then
		for i = 3, #a do if typeof(a[i]) == "Vector3" then a[i] = plain end end
	else
		a[2] = aim
		if typeof(a[4]) == "Vector3" then a[4] = plain end
		if typeof(a[5]) == "number" then a[5] = 0 end
	end
end

local old
old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local method = getnamecallmethod()
	local name = method == "FireServer" and FIRE[self]
	if name then
		local a, n = { ... }, select("#", ...)
		pcall(rewrite, name, a)
		setnamecallmethod(method)
		return old(self, table.unpack(a, 1, n))
	end
	return old(self, ...)
end))

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end

        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end


local function ShowLoadingMessage()
    local loadingLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    loadingLabel.Name = "LoadingMessage"
    loadingLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    loadingLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loadingLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    loadingLabel.FontFace = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/Inconsolata.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    loadingLabel.TextSize = 14
    loadingLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    loadingLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": ..."
    loadingLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    
    local dots = 0
    local animationRunning = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while animationRunning and loadingLabel.Parent do
            dots = (dots % 3) + 1
            loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": " .. string.rep(".", dots)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")

	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)

	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then

		holding = false

end)

        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then

        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {

                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),

            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)

    end
